prompt: Write a one-star review of the Statue of Liberty from a reviewer who is upset that you have to take a boat.
response:
**★☆☆☆☆ – "Overrated and Overpriced Ferry Scam"**

Wow, what a *scam*. The Statue of Liberty is just a giant green lady standing in the middle of the water—big deal! But do you know what *is* a big deal? The fact that you can’t even *walk* to see her! Nope, you have to pay an arm and a leg for a ferry just to get within gawking distance. And don’t even get me started on the crowds—it’s like Disney World, but with less fun and more seagulls.

The statue itself? Meh. I’ve seen bigger lawn ornaments. And the "museum" inside the pedestal? A few dusty plaques and a gift shop trying to sell me a $20 foam crown. Save your money and just look at it from the shore—it’s the same view, minus the motion sickness and the guy behind you taking 500 selfies.

Would not recommend unless you *love* being herded onto a boat like cattle. 1/5 stars—would rather visit a rest stop.
